tour.garden: Quests, the Light Garden and your rare firefly collection live here. Build your garden with the jars you fill.
hint.1.title: Fog waves
hint.1.body: Fog rolls through the swamp now and then. Fireflies inside it are hard to see, your ring shrinks there and Light Spirits can't catch them. But fog brings fireflies: when it passes the forest is full. Your garden Lantern level grows the ring inside fog.
hint.2.title: Mushroom chain
hint.2.body: Tap a glowing mushroom: it bursts, sends nearby fireflies to the jar and jumps to ripe mushrooms close by. Tap just as the ring closes on the mushroom for a bigger burst.
hint.3.title: Crystals
hint.3.body: The cave has colored fireflies. Each color fills the crystal of the same color on the left. When all three are full they resonate: 30 s of ×2 Light and a big reward. One color is always scarce, chase it.
hint.4.title: Wind fireflies
hint.4.body: Wind blows through the canyon and bright fireflies race past. Catch them with your ring for a big reward each. Light Spirits can't catch them.
boss.title: The Giant Firefly woke up
boss.body: Catch {{goal}} fireflies in {{sec}} seconds to feed it light. Reward: {{reward}} Light and {{tokens}} jars.
